in_latin.name: Gregoria
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Gregoria is derived from the Latin name Gregorius, which means vigilant, watchful, alert. The name Gregorius comes from the Latin adjective gregorius, which means swift, quick. In Christian tradition, the name Gregoria is associated with Pope Gregory the Great, one of the most important popes in the history of the Christian Church. The name Gregoria has been used in various forms throughout history, including in medieval Europe, where it was popularized by the cult of St. Gregory.
